games.title: Tic Tac Goal
games.rules: Fill a cell with a player of the two squads who meets both its row and column criteria. A wrong answer loses the turn; 20 s per turn, 10 minutes per game. Three in a row wins.

games.title: Guess the player
games.rules: A player's whole career, with the transfer fees and the current club hidden: pick the right name among four. 5 questions, 20 s each.

games.title: Match quiz
games.rules: Questions on this match's first half, at half-time.

prize.name: Lamplighters Store voucher
prize.description: A 50-euro voucher for the Lamplighters Store, the club shop at the foot of the Main Stand (sector W1).
prize.how_to_claim: The winner sees the voucher in statseat and shows it at the store counter, on match day or within 30 days.
